hero.title:
We Believe Small
*Innovations*
Create Big Change
hero.subtitle: From a single spark of conviction in Onitsha to 12,000 lives touched across Nigeria — this is the story of OneGrid Energies.

belief.lead: OneGrid Energies was founded on a simple belief: sustainable change does not always begin with massive systems, but with simple ideas capable of transforming lives.

paragraphs.text: What started as a vision to reduce energy poverty and environmental waste has grown into a movement focused on reducing darkness across underserved communities.

Through the recycling of waste plastic bottles and discarded laptop batteries, we create solar-powered lanterns that provide light, hope, and opportunity to children and families without reliable access to electricity.

Beyond our community impact projects, we also provide solar installation services, CCTV solutions, renewable energy training, and clean energy products that help homes, businesses, schools, and healthcare centers transition toward sustainable energy.
At OneGrid Energies, we are not just building energy systems. We are building hope, opportunity, and a brighter future.

commitments.text: Transforming waste plastic and discarded batteries into sustainable solutions.
Empowering young people through technical training.
Building systems that create hope, dignity, and opportunity in underserved communities.

milestones.title: The Spark
milestones.description: OneGrid Energies was registered with a mission to reduce energy poverty in Nigeria through innovation and recycling.

milestones.title: OnePlastic Is Born
milestones.description: First prototype lanterns built from waste plastic and discarded laptop batteries. The world's attention begins to turn.

milestones.title: OneHealth Launch
milestones.description: Partnership with rural maternity clinics. Solar boxes delivered to help midwives work safely after sunset.

milestones.title: Community Scale
milestones.description: OneBox stations deployed. Training Academy launched. 40+ green jobs created for young Nigerians.

milestones.title: National Expansion
milestones.description: 12,000+ lives impacted. Investors, NGOs and government agencies take notice. The movement grows.

values.title: What We Stand For
values.subtitle: These principles guide every decision, every lantern, every life we touch.

items.title: Circular Innovation
items.description: We believe waste is a resource waiting to be unlocked. Every discarded battery, every plastic bottle is an opportunity.

items.title: Community First
items.description: We design for people, not boardrooms. Every solution must work for the communities it serves before it works for anyone else.

items.title: Radical Simplicity
items.description: The best solutions are the ones anyone can use, anyone can fix, and anyone can replicate. Complexity is a barrier to impact.

items.title: Environmental Integrity
items.description: Clean energy delivered by clean means. We hold ourselves to the same environmental standards we advocate for.

items.title: Youth Empowerment
items.description: Africa's greatest resource is her young people. We invest in them as technicians, entrepreneurs, and climate leaders.

items.title: Transparent Impact
items.description: We count every lantern, measure every tonne, and report every outcome with honesty — because trust is earned, not assumed.

sustainability.title:
Built To Last,
Built To Scale
sustainability.paragraph_1: OneGrid Energies isn't built on charity — it's built on circular economics. Every lantern sold funds the next one. Every charging station generates revenue that sustains the community that hosts it.
sustainability.paragraph_2: Our model proves that social impact and commercial viability are not in tension — they amplify each other. We're a social enterprise designed to outlast its funding rounds.
sustainability.paragraph_3: By diverting waste plastics and batteries from landfills, we address two environmental crises simultaneously: solid waste pollution and energy poverty. One problem, one solution, twice the impact.

cta.title: Join The Movement
cta.text: Whether you're an investor, a donor, an NGO, or just someone who believes no child should study by candlelight — there is a place for you in this story.
